parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the outer casing of the display, made of durable ABS plastic, providing structural support and protection for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the screen and buttons in place, protects internal electronics, and provides mounting points for installation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: The screen is the main display surface, made of glass, used to show visual information and user interface elements.
parts.Functional_description: It displays images, text, and interactive elements for user control and feedback.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is stationary but responds to touch input if it is a touchscreen.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A tactile button made of silicone rubber, located on the side of the display.
parts.Functional_description: Used to control power or menu navigation functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary control button made of silicone rubber.
parts.Functional_description: Used for adjusting settings or selecting options on the display.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.
